# 🎩 OpenClaw AI Agent Observability V3

Real-time monitoring of AI agent operations, GenAI metrics, traces, and logs.

1.title: Active Sessions
1.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and span.name == "openclaw.request"
| summarize sessions = countDistinct(openclaw.session.key), by:{gen_ai.agent.name}
| sort sessions desc

2.title: Total Token Usage (24h)
2.query:
timeseries token_usage = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage)
| summarize total_tokens = sum(token_usage)
| fieldsAdd total_tokens = round(total_tokens, decimals: 0)

3.title: Avg Agent Turn Duration
3.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and span.name == "openclaw.agent.turn"
| fieldsAdd duration_ms = toDouble(duration) / 1000000
| summarize avg_ms = avg(duration_ms), p95_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95)

4.title: Error Rate
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway"
| fieldsAdd is_error = if(status.code == "Error", 1, 0)
| summarize error_rate = 100 * sum(is_error) / count()
| fieldsAdd error_rate = round(error_rate, decimals: 2)

6.title: Token Usage by Model & Type
6.query: timeseries token_usage = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage), by:{gen_ai.token.type, gen_ai.request.model}, interval:10m

7.title: Token Usage Breakdown (Input vs Output vs Cache)

8.title: Cache Efficiency

10.title: Agent Turn Duration by Agent
10.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and span.name == "openclaw.agent.turn"
| fieldsAdd duration_ms = toDouble(duration) / 1000000
| makeTimeseries avg_ms = avg(duration_ms), p95_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95), by:{gen_ai.agent.name}, interval:5m

11.title: Model Call Duration by Provider
11.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and startsWith(span.name, "chat ")
| fieldsAdd duration_ms = toDouble(duration) / 1000000
| makeTimeseries avg_ms = avg(duration_ms), p95_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95), by:{gen_ai.provider.name}, interval:5m

12.title: Tool Call Performance (Top 15)
12.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and startsWith(span.name, "execute_tool ")
| fieldsAdd duration_ms = toDouble(duration) / 1000000
| summarize avg_ms = avg(duration_ms), p95_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95), count = count(), by:{span.name}
| sort count desc
| limit 15

13.title: Tool Call Volume Over Time
13.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and startsWith(span.name, "execute_tool ")
| makeTimeseries calls = count(), by:{span.name}, interval:5m

15.title: Recent Sessions (Trace Overview)
15.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and span.name == "openclaw.request"
| fields timestamp, trace_id, openclaw.session.key, gen_ai.agent.name, duration
| fieldsAdd duration_ms = toDouble(duration) / 1000000
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 20

16.title: Span Distribution by Type
16.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway"
| summarize count = count(), by:{span.name}
| sort count desc
| limit 20

18.title: Sub-agent Spawn Rate
18.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and span.name == "openclaw.subagent.spawn"
| makeTimeseries spawns = count(), by:{openclaw.subagent.child_agent_name}, interval:5m

19.title: Cron Job Execution Status
19.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and startsWith(span.name, "openclaw.cron.")
| summarize count = count(), by:{span.name, status.code}
| sort count desc

21.title: Error Logs by Component
21.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and status == "error"
| summarize count = count(), by:{source}
| sort count desc
| limit 15

22.title: Recent Error Logs
22.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway" and status == "error"
| fields timestamp, content, source, openclaw.session.key
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 20

23.title: Log Volume Over Time
23.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "openclaw-gateway"
| makeTimeseries volume = count(), by:{status}, interval:5m
